examples.text: Der Keiler versuchte der alten Frau einzureden, dass sie unbedingt diese Zeitschriften abonnieren muss.

examples.text: „So fürchterlich diese wilden Bachen oft sind, so sind die Keiler doch weit grausamer und gefährlicher. glosses: An animal, such as a bull elephant or a boar, with large tusks.

examples.text: By climbing trees they had had a fairly good view of the herd, which they described as numbering several large tuskers, a great many cows and calves, and full-grown bulls whose ivory would be worth having.

The man was deeply shamed by the invitation since he could not possibly reciprocate, and he had to send the tusker itself as payment for the invitation gifts.
